# pvecli config remove

Remove a profile or all profiles.

```text
pvecli config remove [NAME] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NAME` | Profile name. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-al`, `--all` | Remove all profiles. |
